name: Assured Solar Energy
old_description: I think it’s really important to find a company that knows the neighborhood, knows the community. Assured is a company that’s been around since 2006 and has made a great devoted effort to understand the technology and to know its neighbors. And I think that that leaves us in a position that lets neighbors know that they’re going to have somebody who knows them, answer the phone, be able to look at your system and know what’s going on, and help you feel confident that you’ve got a power source that you can rely on, help you control your home, and have an investment that’s going to continue to serve you.
about:
Assured Solar Energy is based in North Yarmouth, Maine, and has been operating since 2006. The company was founded by Rob Taisey, who had been involved in the solar industry since the early 1980s. Taisey created Assured Solar Energy to bring his experience to residential, commercial, and agricultural customers throughout the state.

The firm specializes in the design and installation of photovoltaic (PV) arrays, offering both grid-tied and off-grid solar installations, battery backup solutions, EV fast chargers, and work on island and remote sites. With a team of more than 20 people, Assured Solar handles projects from initial design through installation and post-installation service.

Customers include homeowners, businesses, and farms across Maine. The company has installed systems for residential properties, commercial buildings, and agricultural operations, and also provides repair services for existing installations regardless of original installer.

Assured Solar emphasizes its deep community roots, stating that knowing the neighborhood allows them to provide responsive service and safe, neat installations using what they describe as the best available technologies.
